name: Colombo National Museum
description: The largest museum in Sri Lanka, housing royal regalia and ancient artifacts from the Kandyan kingdom.

name: Gangaramaya Temple
description: A highly revered temple mixing modern architecture and cultural essence, situated near Beira Lake.

name: Galle Face Green
description: A popular ocean-side urban park in the heart of Colombo. Great for sunset views and street food.

name: Dehiwala Zoo
description: The National Zoological Gardens of Sri Lanka, home to diverse wildlife and beautiful landscaped gardens.

name: Seethawaka Botanical Garden
description: A serene botanical garden located in the wet zone of Sri Lanka, perfect for nature walks.

name: Diyasaru Park
description: An urban wetland park in Thalawathugoda, excellent for bird watching and nature photography.

name: Negombo Beach
description: A vibrant coastal stretch in Gampaha district known for its golden sands, fishing communities, and lively atmosphere.

name: Hamilton Canal
description: A historic canal in Negombo built during the colonial era, lined with colorful fishing boats.
